snippet.title: Ronaldo’s Last Day At Real Madrid..💔😢
snippet.description:
On Cristiano Ronaldo’s last day at Real Madrid CF, Real Madrid faced Liverpool F.C.. Before kickoff, Cristiano Ronaldo got ready for the match and went around motivating all of his teammates. But Marcelo couldn’t even look at Ronaldo. As Ronaldo’s best friend, he already knew this would be Ronaldo’s final day at Real Madrid. A few moments later, Ronaldo began praying. He kissed a photo of his father, looked at it for a few seconds, and quietly said, “I’m gonna make it.” After the first half, Ronaldo sat on the bench one last time, knowing it was his final match for Real Madrid. Then the coach started explaining the tactics for the second half, but Ronaldo didn’t hear a single word. He was lost in his thoughts, wondering if he was really ready to leave the club. Late in the second half, Ronaldo received the ball one last time. He was about to score, but a fan suddenly ran onto the field. The referee stopped the match, and Ronaldo’s chance was gone. Without a farewell, Ronaldo left Real Madrid. As he walked away, he gave a simple 👍🏻 and a Painful smile. 💔
